title: Headset Not Detected
fullDescription: Error 108 indicates SteamVR cannot communicate with the Vive HMD. Usually a link box USB or HDMI fault.

fixSteps.title: Reseat link box
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect HDMI, USB, power from link box. Reconnect firmly.

fixSteps.title: Try GPU port
fixSteps.instruction: Move HDMI to a different port directly on GPU.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall USB driver
fixSteps.instruction: SteamVR > Settings > Developer > Remove all SteamVR USB devices, replug.

faq.a: Vive 3-in-1 cable wears out; replacement available.

title: Display Not Found
shortDescription: Headset detected but display does not initialize.
fullDescription: Error 208 means USB is OK but the HMD display is not recognized. Usually GPU driver or HDMI handshake.

fixSteps.title: Update GPU driver
fixSteps.instruction: Install latest Nvidia/AMD driver clean install.

fixSteps.title: Replace HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Test with new HDMI 1.4+ cable in link box.

faq.a: Some adapters work but quality varies.

title: SteamVR Failed to Initialize
fullDescription: Error 301 occurs when vrserver fails to start, often due to corrupted SteamVR install or USB conflicts.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall SteamVR
fixSteps.instruction: Steam > Library > Tools > SteamVR > Uninstall and reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Disable USB selective suspend
fixSteps.instruction: Power Options > USB Selective Suspend > Disabled.

faq.a: Try opt-out of SteamVR beta if on it.

title: Lighthouse Base Station Not Detected
shortDescription: SteamVR shows base station as offline.
fullDescription: Vive base stations 1.0/2.0 must be powered, in line of sight, and on correct channel. Channel conflicts or sync cable issues can disable them.

fixSteps.title: Set channels
fixSteps.instruction: Use SteamVR > Devices > Base Station Settings > set b/c on second.

faq.a: Only for 1.0 if line of sight is blocked.

title: Vive Wand Won't Pair
fullDescription: Pairing requires Bluetooth on or working dongle. Reset by holding system + trigger + grip + trackpad + menu for 5 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Force firmware update
fixSteps.instruction: Devices > Update Firmware while wand wired.

title: Vertical Dead Line on Display
shortDescription: Vertical line of dead pixels visible.
fullDescription: Dead pixel lines on Vive HMD usually indicate a damaged display ribbon. RMA or display replacement required.

fixSteps.title: RMA
fixSteps.instruction: Contact HTC support if under warranty.

fixSteps.title: Display swap
fixSteps.instruction: Out-of-warranty: replace OLED panel via service.

title: Vive Pro Audio Crackles
fullDescription: Audio crackling on Vive Pro is often caused by sample rate mismatch or USB bandwidth saturation.

fixSteps.title: Set 48kHz
fixSteps.instruction: Sound settings > HTC-Vive Pro > Properties > 48000 Hz 16 bit.

fixSteps.title: Move dongles
fixSteps.instruction: Use rear USB ports, separate from controllers.

faq.a: Bypasses internal DAC and often fixes.

title: Vive Stuck on Grey Screen
shortDescription: Headset shows grey loading screen indefinitely.
fullDescription: Grey screen indicates SteamVR stalled. Restart compositor or relaunch SteamVR.

faq.a: SteamVR > Devices > Reset Display Configuration can help.

title: Vive Cosmos Inside-Out Tracking Drift
shortDescription: Cosmos tracking jitters in low light.
fullDescription: Cosmos uses 6 cameras and needs even lighting. Bright daylight, mirrors, and featureless walls degrade tracking.

fixSteps.title: Add lights
fixSteps.instruction: Two diffused lamps at head height.

fixSteps.title: Faceplate upgrade
fixSteps.instruction: Switch to External Tracking Faceplate to use Lighthouse.

faq.a: Cosmos Elite ships with Lighthouse faceplate.

title: HMD or Controller Firmware Update Failed
fullDescription: Cancelled or interrupted firmware updates leave the device stuck. Force-update with the wand wired in.

causes.cause: USB hub between PC and link box

fixSteps.title: Direct USB
fixSteps.instruction: Plug wand directly into rear motherboard USB.

fixSteps.title: Force update
fixSteps.instruction: SteamVR > Devices > Update Firmware. Do not unplug.

faq.a: Older firmware sometimes works but limits compatibility.
